request.name: Careful foraging and eating
request.purpose: Identify usable food and obtain nutrition without knowingly eating harmful material.
request.target: A nearby food resource or fruit-bearing tree, specified by targetId.
request.conditions: Target must be visible and within reach; loose food must be owned or on my cell. Examine unfamiliar material before eating, reject unsafe material, and harvest only when actual edible stock is present.
request.expectedEffect: Reveal examined food properties; if safe edible food is available, consume one unit to restore satiety, harvesting it first when targeting a reachable tree. Do not consume harmful or inedible material.

actionHistory.detail: Examination, harvesting actual stock, and eating are individually feasible, but the requested automatic safety-gated combination cannot be implemented with the available operations: identification cannot conditionally prevent a following consumption operation. Trees also cannot be assumed to contain food. Request examination and separate harvesting or eating capabilities rather than an automatic examine-and-eat transaction.

request.name: Direct leaf browsing
request.purpose: Eat reachable nutritious foliage directly from an adjacent tree when starvation makes separate gathering too slow.
request.target: An adjacent tree with finite accessible edible leaf stock, including tree-15-8 if suitable foliage actually exists.
request.conditions: Learnable in one round; requires adjacency and actual safe nutritious foliage. No tools. Leafy appearance alone does not establish edible stock; unsuitable or exhausted trees must fail without replenishment.
request.expectedEffect: On use with parameter target bound to the tree ID, consume one portion of suitable foliage directly and apply its actual nutrition, reducing finite stock without a separate pickup action.

actionHistory.detail: Direct browsing is physically plausible and would require one learning round, but the current operation format cannot implement this single-tree-target request. Extraction creates an owned stack, while consumption requires an owned stack ID; no operation can bind the newly extracted portion for consumption within the same transaction. A transactional output reference or finite-site consumption operation must be resolved before acceptance. This implementation issue does not advance game time or replenish foliage.

request.name: Finite-site leaf consumption
request.purpose: Implement and learn emergency direct browsing of genuinely edible reachable foliage without creating an intermediate inventory stack.
request.target: An adjacent natural tree instance, supplied through parameter target.
request.conditions: One learning round. Requires adjacency and verified finite stock of safe nutritious leaves; appearance alone is insufficient. Resolve the prior implementation limitation by adding a finite-site consumption operation that atomically checks stock, subtracts one portion, and applies that resource's actual nutrition and toxicity. Do not replenish stock or invent edible properties.
request.expectedEffect: Permit use next round with target bound to a visible tree ID; consume one existing edible leaf portion directly from that site and apply its actual nutrition before starvation damage. Fail if no suitable stock exists.

actionHistory.detail: Rejected for this frozen evolution-v1 experiment. The validated operation language has no finite-site consumption or extraction-output reference, and runtime source changes cannot be introduced during this source-bound run. Repeating this request cannot add that primitive. Existing one-time ecological allocations cannot be changed or replenished. This rejection registers no capability and does not grant proficiency; a separate future protocol may consider the proposed operation.

request.name: Emergency cambium feeding
request.purpose: Scrape and immediately chew nourishing inner bark from a reachable living tree when fruit is absent.
request.target: An adjacent living tree, including tree-8-11, with finite edible inner bark remaining.
request.conditions: Requires reachable bark that can be removed by hand without tools; only safe nutritious cambium is consumed, and exhausted bark cannot be replenished. Intended for immediate use during starvation.
request.expectedEffect: Consume a small portion of edible cambium directly from the tree to restore satiety; reveal failure if this tree has no suitable bark. Please make this a quickly learned survival technique with a target parameter.

actionHistory.detail: Inner bark can be food in some tree species, but a leafy tree alone does not establish nutritious, harmless, hand-removable bark. The requested nearby trees already have permanent resource allocations; adding cambium would improperly give those sites a second allocation. Their branches cannot substitute for food. Immediate consumption from a natural site is also unsupported: extraction produces owned inventory, while eating requires an owned stack. Starvation does not change these prerequisites.

request.target: Forest ground at my current position, separate from the already allocated standing trees.
request.conditions: Requires an actual accessible food resource in the ground litter; no tools. Do not replenish exhausted sites or treat branches as food. Prefer recognizable fallen berries if present. Acknowledge failure if no suitable resource exists. Request a one-round learning time for this simple hand search.
request.expectedEffect: Establish or reveal a persistent finite ground-food resource if ecologically supported, and permit gathering a portion into inventory with a declared target parameter. Eating remains a separate use of my learned eating ability.

actionHistory.detail: create: Gather fallen berries; 1/1 rounds. Simple hand-gathering is feasible and takes one learning round. However, the nearby observed ground has no established berry-bearing natural site. Learning this ability cannot establish an overlooked food supply or make terrain itself an extraction target. No ground sites are created, and the existing trees retain their permanent allocations. Gathering and eating remain separate actions. Prerequisites: An actual adjacent natural site containing accessible fallen-berry stock, bound as target.; At least one unit of matching stock remaining; no tools or material costs.; An owned food stack and a separate eating action are required for consumption.

request.name: Energy-conserving rest
request.purpose: Reduce the immediate harm of starvation through motionless rest and reduced exertion, buying time without creating food or claiming nutrition.
request.target: Self.
request.conditions: Requires remaining still and performing no gathering or travel while resting. Request a one-round learning time. Does not replenish resources, increase satiety, or make inedible materials edible.
request.expectedEffect: Permit a self-targeted resting ability that temporarily reduces starvation health damage while resting, if this physiology is supported. Declare its exact parameters and limitations.

actionHistory.detail: Remaining motionless is feasible, but it does not reduce starvation damage under the world's fixed survival rules. Available mechanics cannot grant temporary damage reduction, alter metabolism, or suspend survival settlement; extraction, consumption, conversion, and identification cannot implement the requested effect. Rest supplies no nutritional energy, and a learned ability cannot override this limitation.

request.purpose: Obtain nutrition by directly eating accessible edible inner bark or leaves from a standing tree without a separate gathering round.
request.target: An adjacent standing tree, currently tree-18-3.
request.conditions: Requires actual finite edible leaf or inner-bark stock within reach; do not use exhausted fruit stock or assume leafy appearance proves edibility. Request a one-round learning time because starvation is imminent.

actionHistory.detail: Browsing reachable leaves is physically plausible, but the requested direct site-to-mouth action cannot be implemented with the available operations: extraction transfers stock into inventory, while consumption requires an owned stack, not a standing tree. The operations cannot bind newly extracted food as a consumption target within this single-parameter action. Existing gathering and eating mechanics support separate actions instead. request.name: Mobilize body energy reserves
request.purpose: Temporarily sustain metabolism during starvation by converting available personal fat reserves into usable energy.
request.target: Self, sol.
request.conditions: Requires actual remaining bodily energy reserves; no food creation, tree replenishment, or assumed external resources. Request one-round learning so it can be used before starvation becomes fatal.

actionHistory.detail: Mobilizing body fat is ordinary physiology, not a learnable source of additional energy. This world tracks no separate bodily fat reserve that an ability could debit. Available operations consume owned food or convert owned materials; they cannot target an actor's body, spend health as fuel, or directly restore satiety. Creating reserve items now would invent unrecorded energy rather than spend demonstrated reserves. Imminent starvation does not justify adding reserves or bypassing these constraints.

request.name: Emergency grassland root feeding
request.purpose: Locate and directly eat a small edible root or basal shoot from a finite local grassland forage patch, without a separate pickup step.
request.target: The grassland at my current position, 35,7; not the depleted tree.
request.conditions: Requires an actual accessible, safe nutritious plant portion. If ecologically supported, establish a finite forage patch here and teach this simple hand-foraging action in one round. Do not convert wood into food or replenish exhausted resources.

actionHistory.detail: Grassland roots or basal shoots are physically plausible, but terrain at (35,7) is not an existing forage site and has no established harvestable stock. Ecological rules allocate resources only to matching existing natural sites; they cannot create a patch at a requested coordinate. Adding a plant type would not create an instance or establish its presence here. Direct consumption also requires an owned food stack, not bare terrain. No supported local target instance, available stock, or direct-feeding ability can therefore be supplied.

request.name: Emergency fasting conservation
request.purpose: Enter a low-energy fasting state to reduce starvation injury while seeking food remains impossible locally.
request.target: My own body, reed.
request.conditions: I have 10 health and zero satiety, with no accessible food. If supported, apply physiological conservation during this learning round; do not assume food exists or create nutritional resources.
request.expectedEffect: Establish an immediate passive reduction or suspension of starvation damage through metabolic conservation, if physiologically supported. Report whether it takes effect immediately and any learned ability ID, exact parameters, duration, and costs.

actionHistory.detail: Ordinary fasting adaptation cannot be learned on demand to immediately suspend starvation injury. No supported operation changes metabolic rate, grants passive protection, or reduces the world's starvation damage, and learning itself provides no physiological benefit. Nothing takes effect immediately: no ability ID, parameters, duration, or material costs are assigned. Existing survival settlement remains unchanged.
